acoustic.title: Acoustic test
acoustic.intro: A hearing screening test: for each ear you'll hear a series of tones that start very quiet and gradually become more audible. Press "I hear it" as soon as you perceive the sound.
acoustic.medicalDisclaimer: A self-assessment test, not a calibrated clinical audiometric exam. It does not replace the advice of a doctor or audiologist.
acoustic.deviceCheckBody: For a more accurate result we recommend using headphones, or turning on speakerphone at a moderate volume.
acoustic.deviceCheckMobileWarning: On smartphone you must wear headphones or turn on speakerphone before starting: the earpiece speaker is not suitable for this test.
acoustic.instructionsBody: The test takes about 2-3 minutes and covers both ears across 6 different frequencies, from low to high. For each sound, press "I hear it" as soon as you can perceive it, even faintly. If you press nothing, the test automatically moves to the next sound after a few seconds. Between sounds there is always a pause of silence of varying length: tap only when you really hear the sound.

acuity.title: Visual acuity
acuity.intro: The classic check with the letter “E”: say which way it faces as it gets smaller and smaller. Speed doesn’t matter: answer calmly.
acuity.medicalDisclaimer: A self-check, not an eye examination. The result depends on screen, light and distance and is only indicative. If you wear glasses or lenses for close-up vision, keep them on.
acuity.how1: Hold the screen about {distance} cm from your eyes, in a well-lit room.
acuity.how2: One eye at a time: cover the other with the palm of your hand, without pressing.
acuity.how3: For each “E”, tap the arrow for the direction its “legs” point. If you can’t see it, tap “I can’t see it”.

acuity.how5: On a computer you can also answer with the arrow keys: handy when you’re far from the screen.

amsler.title: Amsler grid
amsler.intro: A simple check to notice whether the lines of a grid look wavy, blurred or missing. No time limit and no score.
amsler.medicalDisclaimer: A self-check, not an eye examination. If you wear reading glasses, keep them on. If you notice wavy lines or missing areas for the first time, contact an eye doctor without delay.
amsler.how1: Hold the screen about 30 cm from your eyes, in a well-lit room.
amsler.how2: One eye at a time: cover the other and keep looking at the black dot in the centre, without moving your gaze.
amsler.how3: Tap the squares where the lines look wavy, blurred, faded or missing. If everything looks normal, don’t tap anything.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Kumani doesn't sell dreams: it lends hands. Discover the story, the meaning of the name and the manifesto of Kumani, the community of professional tools for people who work for themselves.
aboutPage.title: Hands that lend you a hand.
aboutPage.subtitle: Not a company that sells dreams: a community that lends hands.
aboutPage.namePara1: KUMANI comes from two words. KU comes from the Japanese 組 (kumi): “group, gathering, people working side by side.” MANI is the oldest Italian word for work: the hands that build, help, create.
aboutPage.namePara2: KUMANI means “hands together”: because anyone working alone needs extra hands, and a community willing to lend them.
aboutPage.namePara3: At the heart of Kumani there have never been algorithms, compensation plans or promises. There are people.
aboutPage.story1Text: For years we lived alongside extraordinary people: salespeople, consultants, networkers, artisans of their own business. People with big hearts and an empty toolbox. Around them, a market selling dreams: promised cars, yachts in photographs, courses worth thousands of euros, and seven different paid apps to do what should be done in one place. Hands held out to promise. Never a hand held out to help.
aboutPage.story2Text1: Then one evening, late, we watched a colleague redo the same flyer by hand for the third time, and reply to the twentieth WhatsApp message by copying and pasting the same words again. And in that moment came the question that changed everything: “This person doesn't need promises. She needs hands.”
aboutPage.story2Text2: A hand to hold her QR code. One to keep her diary. One to write her quote. One to collect her reviews. One to tell her, when she's exhausted: close your eyes and breathe.
aboutPage.story3Text: That's how KUMANI was born: not a company that sells dreams, but a community that lends hands. One place, every tool. An honest price: €49 a year for everyone with the Base plan, €149 a year for professionals with the Pro plan. Public rules, real benefits, zero mirages. Because before being professionals, we're human. And humans, when they have the right hands, do extraordinary things on their own.
aboutPage.manifesto4Rest: €49 a year for the Base plan, €149 a year for the Pro plan for professionals.
aboutPage.manifesto5Rest: that's why we also teach you to breathe.
aboutPage.manifesto6Rest: public rules, real benefits, no tricks.
aboutPage.closingTitle: Kumani. Hands that lend you a hand.
aboutPage.closingSubtitle: Public rules, real benefits, an honest price forever: €49 a year with Base, €149 a year with Pro.

contactPage.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to the questions we receive most often.
contactPage.faq1Q: I can't log in to my account: what can I do?
contactPage.faq1A: Make sure you're using the same email you signed up with. If you can't remember your password, use "Forgotten your password?" on the login page: we'll send you a link to create a new one (check your spam folder too). If you still can't get in, write to us using the form above and choose "Support and assistance".
contactPage.faq2Q: How much do the Base and Pro subscriptions cost?
contactPage.faq2A: The Base subscription costs €49 a year, Pro €149 a year. Pro unlocks all the tools and advanced features, and you can try it free for 15 days before deciding.
contactPage.faq3Q: How do renewal and cancellation work?
contactPage.faq3A: The subscription lasts one year. Before it expires we'll remind you about renewal, so you can decide at your own pace. You can cancel whenever you like from the subscription section of your profile: you stay active until the end of the period you've already paid for.
contactPage.faq4Q: What are KU Karma and KU Points?
contactPage.faq4A: They're a way to reward your participation: you earn them by using KUMANI and contributing to the community. They can only be spent within the platform (rewards, perks, discounts) and they aren't money: they can't be converted into cash or transferred outside KUMANI.
contactPage.faq5Q: How do you handle my personal data?
contactPage.faq5A: We only use your data to make KUMANI work and we never sell it to anyone. You'll find all the details in the privacy policy. If you'd like to view, correct or delete your data, write to us choosing the topic "Privacy and personal data".
contactPage.faq6Q: How do I report a problem, abuse or inappropriate behaviour?
contactPage.faq6A: Many items have a "Report" button: it's the quickest way. Alternatively, write to us using the form and tell us what happened, with links or screenshots if you have them. Every report is read by the Staff and handled confidentially.
contactPage.faq7Q: Why do you ask me to verify my identity for Kordata and Events?

checkmail.title: KUMANI CheckMail
checkmail.heroText: Got a suspicious email? Upload or paste it: we check the sender, digital signatures, links, attachments and text, and tell you how risky it is. Scams give themselves away in the details: we read them all.
checkmail.fileHint: The most complete way: save the email as a file (.eml or .msg) and upload it here. That way we also read the hidden headers, which show who really sent it.
checkmail.howToFileTitle: How do I save the email as a file?
checkmail.howToGmail: Gmail (desktop): open the email → ⋮ menu at the top right → "Download message".
checkmail.howToOutlook: Outlook (app): open the email → File → "Save As", or drag it to the desktop.
checkmail.howToOutlookWeb: Outlook.com: open the email → ⋯ → "Download" → "Download as EML".
checkmail.howToThunderbird: Thunderbird: open the email → File → "Save As" → "File".
checkmail.pasteHint: Paste the full source of the email here (headers and text).
checkmail.howToPasteTitle: Where do I find the source?
checkmail.howToPasteGmail: Gmail (desktop): open the email → ⋮ menu → "Show original" → "Copy to clipboard".
checkmail.howToPasteOutlook: Outlook: open the email → ⋯ → "View" → "View message source", then copy everything.
checkmail.quickHint: On your phone? Copy the sender address, the subject and the text of the email.
checkmail.quickNote: Without the file or the source we cannot read the hidden headers, so the check is more limited. If you can, repeat it from a computer.
checkmail.privacyNote: The email is analyzed and not stored: we only keep how many checks you made today. The text may also be read by an artificial intelligence service, which does not use it to train its models.
checkmail.disclaimer: CheckMail provides clues, not certainties: no automatic check catches 100% of scams, and a "low" result does not guarantee the email is safe. When in doubt, do not click, do not reply, and contact the company through its official channels. The result is not an expert assessment.

checkmail.level_high: High risk: almost certainly a scam
checkmail.levelText_high: We found strong signs of a scam. Do not click the links, do not open attachments and do not reply.
checkmail.levelText_medium: There are suspicious signs. Before doing anything, check with the company through its official channels.
checkmail.levelText_low: We found no major signs of a scam. Stay careful anyway: no check is 100% certain.
checkmail.noSignals: No risk signals in the technical checks.
checkmail.aiUnavailable: AI text reading is not available right now: the result is based on the technical checks only.
checkmail.advice_high: Do not click, do not open attachments and do not reply. If you already entered passwords or card details, change the password now and call your bank using the number on the back of your card. Then report the email as spam or phishing and delete it.
checkmail.advice_medium: Do not use the links in the email: open the official website yourself by typing the address, or call the company on a number you know. Never send passwords, codes or card details by email.
checkmail.advice_low: It looks like a normal email, but stay alert: if it asks for money, passwords or codes, always check through official channels before acting.
checkmail.f_auth_dmarc_fail: Your email provider reports that the sender is NOT authentic (DMARC failed).
checkmail.f_auth_spf_dkim_fail: The server that sent the email is not authorized by the sender's domain (SPF/DKIM failed).
checkmail.f_auth_dkim_fail: The sender's digital signature is invalid (DKIM failed for {domain}): the email may be forged.
checkmail.f_auth_ok: Sender authentication passed (SPF {spf}, DKIM {dkim}, DMARC {dmarc}): it confirms the sending domain, not that the email is trustworthy.
checkmail.f_no_headers: Without the technical headers the check is partial: upload the file or paste the source for a full check.
checkmail.f_sender_missing: The sender has no email address: genuine messages always have one.
checkmail.f_brand_from_freemail: It claims to be {brand} but writes from a free email address ({domain}).
checkmail.f_brand_domain_mismatch: It claims to be {brand} but the sender's domain ({domain}) is not an official one.
checkmail.f_idn_sender: The sender's domain uses special characters that can imitate normal letters ({domain}).
checkmail.f_display_name_address: The displayed name contains an address ({shown}) different from the real one ({real}).
checkmail.f_reply_to_mismatch: Replies would go to another domain ({replyTo}) instead of {from}.
checkmail.f_link_text_mismatch: A link shows one address but leads elsewhere ({example}).
checkmail.f_link_ip: A link leads to a numeric (IP) address instead of a named website.
checkmail.f_link_shortener: A link is shortened ({domain}) and hides the real destination.

checkmail.f_idn_link: A link uses special characters that can imitate a well-known site.

checkmail.f_attachment_html: Web page attachment ({name}): often a fake login form.
checkmail.f_attachment_archive: Compressed attachment ({name}): it may hide dangerous files.

checkmail.f_content_parcel: It talks about a parcel to release or shipping fees ("{phrase}").
checkmail.f_content_investment: It talks about investments, trading or returns ("{phrase}"): typical of financial scams.
checkmail.f_generic_greeting: Generic greeting ("Dear customer"): people who know you use your name.
checkmail.f_template_placeholder: It contains a forgotten template placeholder ("{text}"): a mass-produced email.
checkmail.f_pressure_foreign_link: It puts you under pressure but the link leads to a site unrelated to the sender ({domain}).
checkmail.f_mixed_script: The text mixes letters from different alphabets to fool spam filters (e.g. "{example}").

oxygen.title: OXYGEN
oxygen.heroText: A simple guide to 4-7-8 breathing: breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out for 8. The circle breathes with you and guides you step by step.
oxygen.chooseMode: How do you want to breathe today?
oxygen.modeGuidedHint: About 3 minutes: we guide you from start to finish, with a few words along the way.
oxygen.modeBreathHint: Go straight to the cycles: the circle and the count, no introduction.
oxygen.eyesNote: With sound or vibration on you can close your eyes: they tell you when to change phase (three different tones: in, hold, out).
oxygen.safety1: Sit or lie down somewhere quiet. Never while driving or doing anything that needs your attention.
oxygen.safety2: If it is your first time, do no more than 4 cycles: your body gets used to it gradually.
oxygen.safety3: If you feel dizzy or uncomfortable, stop and go back to breathing normally.
oxygen.safety4: If holding for 7 seconds is too much, slow down as feels comfortable: the rhythm matters, not perfection.
oxygen.safety5: It does not replace a doctor. If you have breathing or heart problems, or are pregnant, ask your doctor first.
oxygen.doneText: You completed {cycles} cycles of 4-7-8 breathing. Take this calm with you.
oxygen.phaseHint_inhale: Breathe in through your nose, slowly.
oxygen.phaseHint_exhale: Breathe out through your mouth, gently, all the way.
oxygen.prepareText: Empty your lungs completely with a long breath out through your mouth.
oxygen.intro1: Get comfortable. Back straight, shoulders soft, hands resting.
oxygen.intro2: These minutes are just for you. You do not have to do anything special: just breathe.
oxygen.intro3: For a moment, notice your breath as it is. Air comes in, air goes out. Change nothing.
oxygen.intro4: 4-7-8 breathing slows your rhythm and helps body and mind calm down.
oxygen.intro5: You will breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds, hold for 7 and breathe out through your mouth for 8. The circle will guide you.
oxygen.cycleTip2: With each breath out, let go of a little tension: shoulders, jaw, forehead.
oxygen.cycleTip3: If your mind wanders, that is fine: gently bring your attention back to the breath.
oxygen.cycleTipLast: Last cycle. Take all the time you need.
oxygen.outro1: Now let your breath return to its natural rhythm.
oxygen.outro2: Notice how you feel now: your body, your thoughts, your heartbeat.
oxygen.outro3: When your breath slows down, your body gets a simple message: you are safe.
oxygen.outro4: Come back whenever you like: before sleep, before an important moment, or when anxiety rises.
oxygen.disclaimer: OXYGEN is a relaxation exercise, not a medical device: it does not replace a doctor's advice or any treatment. Stop the exercise if you feel unwell.

verificaIban.signal_privateSellerForeign: The IBAN is from another country ({ibanCountry}), but the seller says they are a private person in your country. It isn’t necessarily a scam, but it’s a common sign in fake listings: ask for an explanation and, if you can, pay in person on delivery.
verificaIban.signal_privateSellerTip: Always stay in the platform’s chat and payment system. Be wary of anyone asking for an advance by bank transfer or top-up, or in a hurry to close the deal.
verificaIban.signal_holidayRentalForeign: The IBAN is from another country ({ibanCountry}). If the property is in your country, don’t ignore this sign: in fake listings the “owner” often lives abroad and asks for a deposit by bank transfer.
verificaIban.signal_holidayRentalTip: Only pay through the booking platform. Check the address on a map and the photos with a reverse image search. A reasonable deposit is around 20%: be wary of anyone asking for 50% or more before you’ve seen the place.
verificaIban.signal_onlineShopForeign: The IBAN is from another country ({ibanCountry}). Many genuine shops sell from abroad, but check that the website shows a company name, VAT number and address.
verificaIban.signal_onlineShopTip: A shop that only accepts bank transfers or crypto is a red flag. Prefer protected payments (credit card, PayPal “goods and services”) and look for reviews on independent websites.
verificaIban.signal_investmentStrong: Stop before you pay. Fake investments are among the scams that cost people the most: guaranteed or very high returns, celebrities “recommending” them, pressure to hurry and transfers to unknown accounts are typical signs.
verificaIban.signal_investmentCheck: Before sending any money, check that the firm is authorised on the websites of Consob and Banca d’Italia (and, if you live elsewhere, your own country’s financial regulator), and look at Consob’s list of blocked websites. Never install remote access apps such as AnyDesk.
verificaIban.signal_billCheck: Check the IBAN on the organisation’s official website or on the bill itself, never from a message, text or email. In Italy, taxes and fines are usually paid through pagoPA.
verificaIban.signal_billChanged: If you were told about a “new IBAN” by email, confirm the change by calling the number you already have, not the one in the message.
verificaIban.signal_familyCall: Call the number you know before paying. If a relative or friend writes from a new number or is in a big hurry, call them back on their usual number.
verificaIban.signal_familyPassword: Ask a question only they could answer, or use a family password: these days even voices can be cloned.
verificaIban.signal_otherTip: If the IBAN reached you by message, email or chat, check it through another channel: a call to a number you know or the official website. Hurry, secrecy and unusual payment methods are always warning signs.
verificaIban.keySentence: A valid IBAN doesn’t guarantee that the recipient is honest: it only tells you the code is written correctly.
verificaIban.tipInstant: An instant transfer can’t be undone: the money arrives within seconds.
verificaIban.tipProtected: When you can, prefer protected payments, such as a credit card or PayPal “goods and services”, which let you open a dispute.
verificaIban.tipPayee: Look at the recipient name your bank shows you: since October 2025, European banks compare the name with the IBAN (Verification of Payee). If you’re told the name doesn’t match, stop.

registrazione.title: How to sign up
registrazione.summary: Create your KUMANI account in a few minutes and activate it with the code you receive by email.
registrazione.step1Text: On the homepage, tap the gold “Get Started” button at the top right. If someone sent you their invite link, open it: their code is filled in automatically.
registrazione.step2Text: Enter your first name, last name, email and a password of at least 6 characters, then choose your country and your city.
registrazione.step2Tip: Use an email you check often: that’s where the code to activate your account arrives.
registrazione.step3Text: If a Kumano invited you, enter their invite code. If you received a KUMANI voucher, enter it in the “Activation voucher code” field: your subscription is activated right away. If you have a shop, a practice or a business, tick “I’m a professional”. Then tap “Create your account”.
registrazione.step4Text: We send you a code by email. Enter it in the “Verification code” field and tap “Verify and activate account”. Done: you’re in!
registrazione.step4Tip: Can’t find the email? Check your spam folder or tap “Resend code”.

accesso.title: How to log in
accesso.summary: Get into your account and recover your password if you’ve forgotten it.
accesso.step1Text: On the homepage, tap “Log in”, enter the email and password you chose when you signed up and tap “Log in”.
accesso.step2Text: Tap “Forgot password?” below the login button.
accesso.step3Text: Enter your email and tap “Reset Password”: we send you a code to choose a new one. Then log in with the new password.
accesso.step3Tip: You can add KUMANI to your phone’s Home screen: it opens like an app.

dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.summary: What you’ll find in the dashboard and how to reach the services you use most.
dashboard.step1Text: At the top you can change the language, open your profile and the Wallet, and log out. The star takes you to your favorite services.
dashboard.step2Text: The “Free” tier holds the services included for every member, with no time limit. Tap “Open” to use them and the little star to add them to your favorites.
dashboard.step3Text: Services are split into three tiers: Free, Base and Pro. A Base or Pro subscription unlocks every service in that tier; with a Pass you can also activate a single service.
dashboard.step4Text: Further down you’ll see the KU Karma you collect every day by logging in, your subscription status (with “Subscribe now” or “Activate via Voucher”) and your personal invite code.
dashboard.step5Title: The Community and the other pages
dashboard.step5Text: At the bottom you’ll find your KUMANI Community and quick links to the other pages: Community, Wallet and Noticeboard.

invito.title: Inviting with your link
invito.summary: Share your invite code or link and follow the people who join your KUMANI star.
invito.step1Text: Your personal invite code is in the dashboard. Tap the icon next to it to copy it: whoever signs up with your link joins your KUMANI star.
invito.step2Text: On the Community page your link is ready: copy it, tap “Invite on WhatsApp” or “Share…” to send it with Instagram, Telegram and the other apps on your phone.
invito.step2Tip: A personal message works better than one sent to everyone: tell them why KUMANI is useful to you.
invito.step3Text: The star shows the 5 people you invited directly and how many active people there are under each position. Anyone who signed up but hasn’t activated a subscription yet appears under “Not yet KUMANI”.
invito.step4Text: The rules are in the Wallet: you receive KU Points when someone you invited activates a subscription by paying with a card or upgrades to Pro, and with the Welcome Bonus.

voucher.title: Creating and using vouchers
voucher.summary: Vouchers come as rewards with qualifications: give them to new people and activate a voucher you received.
voucher.step1Text: With the Base or Pro activations of the people you invited and your KU Points you become Kuman Green, Star or Black: the reward vouchers appear automatically in your Wallet, in the vouchers section.
voucher.step2Text: Copy the code or send it on WhatsApp: whoever receives it enters it when signing up and gets a year of KUMANI Base. If you sell it, prepare the receipt with “Receipt”.
voucher.step3Text: Enter the code in the “Received a voucher?” field and tap “Redeem”: your subscription is activated right away. You can also enter it when you sign up.

wallet.title: Using the Wallet
wallet.summary: Your card, points, donations, badges and receipts: here’s what you’ll find in the Wallet.
wallet.step1Text: At the top is your KUMANI card with member number, active plan and expiry date. You can save the QR code with “Download QR”.
wallet.step2Text: Here you see your KU Karma, earned every day by logging in and using the tools, and your KU Points, received when someone you invited activates a subscription. Points are not money and can only be used inside the platform.
wallet.step3Text: In the Donations section you can donate your KU Points to the association KUMANI supports: every 10 points donated = €1, which KUMANI pays to the association.
wallet.step4Text: The Kuman Green, Kuman Star and Kuman Black qualifications are reached with the activations of the people you invited and your KU Points, and come with reward vouchers. The bar shows how close you are to the next one.
wallet.step5Text: Further down you’ll find Digital Receipts (Pro plan), the coupons you got in the Ecosystem and the subscription renewal discount you can get with KU Karma.

qr_generator.title: Dynamic QR Code
qr_generator.summary: Create the QR code of your invite link, choose the colours and download it to print or share.
qr_generator.step1Text: The QR leads to your personal invite link. The “Target Link” is locked, so whoever scans it always joins your KUMANI star.
qr_generator.step2Text: Change the “QR Code Color” and the “Background Color”, or tap one of the “Quick Themes”.
qr_generator.step2Tip: Keep good contrast between QR and background: a QR that is too light is hard to read.
qr_generator.step3Text: Check the preview and tap “Download PNG”: the image is high resolution, good for printing too.
qr_generator.step4Text: Print it on business cards and flyers, share it on social media or add it to your email signature.

whatsapp_messages.title: WhatsApp Messages
whatsapp_messages.summary: Ready-made messages with your invite link: choose the right tone and send it in seconds.
whatsapp_messages.step1Text: There are 4 messages for different situations: casual, formal, emotional and after a meeting. Your invite link is already in the text.
whatsapp_messages.step2Text: Tap “Send on WhatsApp” to open WhatsApp with the message ready and choose who to send it to. Or tap “Copy message” and paste it wherever you like, even in another app.
whatsapp_messages.step2Tip: In WhatsApp you can edit the text before sending it: add the person’s name.
whatsapp_messages.step3Text: Always personalise the message, don’t send it to too many people at once and follow up with a call or a voice message.

link_in_bio.title: Link in Bio
link_in_bio.summary: Create your personal page with your links, to put in your Instagram, TikTok and other social bios.
link_in_bio.step1Text: In the “Bio Text” field write a sentence about yourself: it appears below your name.
link_in_bio.step2Text: Choose the page colour. You can preview the special themes (Northern lights, Moon over the lake, Savannah sunset) by tapping them: KU Karma are only used if you decide to unlock them.
link_in_bio.step3Text: Tap “Add Link” to add your links (website, social, shop…): your KUMANI invite link is always there. Then tap “Save Page”.
link_in_bio.step3Tip: Further down you can preview how the page will look.
link_in_bio.step4Text: Copy the page link and put it in your social bios, or tap “Visit your Link in Bio” to see it. Remember to save before sharing.

spotlight.title: Kumano of the Day
spotlight.summary: Tell your story and join the community showcase: every day one Kumano is featured. Reserved for active subscribers.
spotlight.step1Text: Fill in your name or nickname (never your surname), city, country, job or passion and a short story that can be read in 20 seconds.
spotlight.step2Text: Tap the KUMANI tools you use most: they appear together with your story.
spotlight.step3Text: Tick the consent to be shown to the community (the one for the homepage is optional) and tap “Save and join the showcase”. The KUMANI Staff approves the story, then it enters the Kumano of the Day rotation.
spotlight.step3Tip: You can remove your story from the showcase or the homepage whenever you like, from this same page.

events.title: KUMANI Events
events.summary: Find community meetups, workshops and evenings, sign up with one tap and get in with your pass.
events.step1Text: Search by city, country, language and date, or tap “Online only” for online events.
events.step2Title: Sign up and get your pass
events.step2Text: Open the event and tap “Join”: you get your pass with QR right away, and you’ll find it in “My passes”. Show it at the entrance: the organiser scans it and you’re in.
events.step2Tip: If the event is full you can join the waiting list: if a spot frees up, you get in automatically.
events.step3Text: Want to organise a meetup in your city or online? Tap “Organise an event”.
events.step4Text: To organise events you need to be a Verified Kumano: tap “Become a verified organiser” and follow the steps. Then, from “My events”, you manage attendees and check-in.

antitruffa.title: Anti-Scam Manual
antitruffa.summary: The most common scams, with real examples and what to do right away: read it, save it and share it with the people you love.
antitruffa.step1Text: At the top, tap “Download or print the manual”: your phone’s or computer’s print window opens, where you can also save it as a PDF.
antitruffa.step2Title: Share it with the people you love
antitruffa.step2Text: Send it to parents, grandparents and friends via WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram, X, LinkedIn or email, or copy the link. Anyone who signs up from your link joins your network.
antitruffa.step3Text: Before clicking, replying or paying, ask yourself the 6 questions of the test: if even one answer is “yes”, it’s almost certainly a scam.
antitruffa.step3Tip: Right below are the 6 golden rules: they alone are enough to avoid most scams.
antitruffa.step4Text: From the contents, go to the chapter you need: email and texts, phone calls, at your front door, chats, shopping, investments… Tap a scam to open it and read examples and what to do. At the end you’ll find what to do right away if you’ve been scammed.

verifica_iban.title: IBAN Check
verifica_iban.summary: Check the IBAN before a bank transfer: whether it’s written correctly, which country it’s from and which warning signs to watch for.
verifica_iban.step1Text: Paste the IBAN you were given, with or without spaces, and tap “Check the IBAN”. The check happens entirely on your phone: the IBAN is never sent or saved.
verifica_iban.step2Text: You see whether the IBAN is written correctly and which country it’s from. For Italian IBANs you also see its parts: CIN, ABI (the bank), CAB (the branch) and account number.
verifica_iban.step2Tip: If there’s a mistake, we tell you where: for example a missing character or two swapped digits.
verifica_iban.step3Text: Choose the closest answer (a private seller, a holiday home, an online shop, an investment…) and your country: we show you the warning signs to watch for.
verifica_iban.step4Text: Remember: a valid IBAN doesn’t guarantee the recipient is honest. Read the tips before paying: an instant transfer can’t be cancelled.

checkmail.title: CheckMail
checkmail.summary: Got a suspicious email? Upload or copy it: we check the sender, links, attachments and text and tell you how risky it is.
checkmail.step1Title: Choose how to load the email
checkmail.step1Text: There are three ways: “Upload the file” (the email saved as .eml or .msg, the most complete), “Paste the source” or “From your phone”. Each one comes with instructions for Gmail, Outlook and other programs.
checkmail.step2Title: Enter the email and analyse it
checkmail.step2Text: From your phone, just copy the sender, subject and text with any links, then tap “Analyze the email”.
checkmail.step2Tip: Below the button you can see how many checks you have left today.
checkmail.step3Text: The result tells you whether the risk is low, medium or high and lists what we found: fake sender, shortened links, pressure, requests for your details…
checkmail.step4Text: Follow the advice: for example don’t click, don’t open attachments and don’t reply. With “Check another email” you start again.
checkmail.step4Tip: CheckMail gives clues, not certainties: if in doubt, contact the company through its official channels.

verifoto.title: VeriFoto
verifoto.summary: Check whether a photo is real or was created or retouched with artificial intelligence, before you trust it.
verifoto.step1Text: Tap “Choose a photo” and pick the image to check (JPG, PNG or WebP up to 15 MB). The basic checks happen on your phone.
verifoto.step2Title: The risk that it’s AI or retouched
verifoto.step2Text: You see a verdict and a risk percentage: 0–30% low, 31–69% uncertain, 70–100% high. Below are the clues found, such as digital certificates and camera data.
verifoto.step3Text: Tap “Retouch map”: areas much brighter than the rest can point to pasted or retouched parts. It’s a visual aid, not proof.
verifoto.step4Title: Second opinion and the original photo
verifoto.step4Text: For an extra check use the AI detector: agree to send a reduced copy of the photo and tap “Analyse with the AI detector”. With Google Lens or TinEye you can search whether the same photo already exists online.
verifoto.step4Tip: VeriFoto gives clues, not certainties: if in doubt, don’t trust it.

documento_sicuro.title: Safe Document
documento_sicuro.summary: Before sending a photo of an ID, add a caption with purpose and date and cover the details that aren’t needed.
documento_sicuro.step1Title: Choose the photo of the document
documento_sicuro.step1Text: Tap “Choose a photo” to pick it from your gallery or “Take a photo”. The photo stays on your phone: it’s never uploaded or saved.
documento_sicuro.step2Title: Cover the details that aren’t needed
documento_sicuro.step2Text: Tap “Cover an area” and drag your finger over the photo to put a black rectangle over the document number, signature or photo, if they weren’t asked for.
documento_sicuro.step2Tip: We also tell you if the photo contains hidden data, such as GPS location: it’s gone from the downloaded copy.
documento_sicuro.step3Text: Choose what you’re sending it for (renting, bank, job, online purchase…) and to whom: the caption with purpose and date repeats diagonally across the whole photo. You can change its text, visibility, size and colour.
documento_sicuro.step3Tip: Use a different caption for each person: if the copy gets passed around, you’ll know where it came from.
documento_sicuro.step4Text: Tap “Download the protected copy” or “Share”: you get a new copy with the caption and covered areas, without hidden data. The original isn’t touched.

listings.title: Community Listings
listings.summary: Post services and products, find what you need and message whoever posted.
listings.step1Text: Type what you’re looking for, choose category, country and city and tap “Search”. Featured listings appear first.
listings.step2Text: Tap “New Listing”: posting costs some KU Karma, shown on the button. Write a title, category and description; price and image are optional.
listings.step2Tip: If you don’t have enough KU Karma, log in every day to collect them. Listings last 30 days, then you can repost them with one click.
listings.step3Text: Choose country and city. For services and consulting, tick “Also available online / remotely”: the listing appears in every city of the country.
listings.step4Text: You can feature the listing right away in the Featured section with KU Points, choosing for how many days. Then tap “Publish Listing”.
listings.step5Text: In “My messages” you’ll find conversations with people who wrote to you about a listing or whom you wrote to. For your privacy, messages are deleted automatically after 30 days.

timebank.title: KUMANI Time Bank
timebank.summary: Help someone for an hour and earn an hour, to spend when you need a hand.
timebank.step1Text: You help someone for an hour and earn an hour, which you spend when you need a hand. Hours aren’t worth money and can’t be turned into points or discounts.
timebank.step2Text: Tap “Verify and join”: you need to have been a member for at least 30 days, a complete profile, be of age, a verified identity (tax code or ID) and accepted rules. Then you create your profile and get your welcome hours.
timebank.step2Tip: You can verify your identity and accept the rules right away, even if some requirement is still missing.
timebank.step3Text: On the board, filter requests and offers by category, in person or online, and city. Post with “Ask for help” or “Offer help”, or reply with “I can help”: hours move from one balance to the other when you both confirm.
timebank.step4Text: The first time, meet in a public place or online. Nobody should ask you for money, gifts or bank details; no professional advice or dangerous jobs. If something’s wrong, report it: the Staff steps in.

convivio.title: Kordata
convivio.summary: Group buying among Kumani: together you buy better, straight from the producer or the shop.
convivio.step1Text: A Kumano proposes a group purchase from a producer or shop and the others join: once the minimum is reached the order goes ahead and everyone pays the supplier directly.
convivio.step2Text: Under “Open” you’ll find active Kordate, by category (food and wine, tech, travel and events, home and energy…). Open the one you like and tap “I’m in”: we’ll let you know when the minimum is reached. Under “Mine” you’ll find the ones you’re part of.
convivio.step2Tip: Once you join you can see who’s taking part and write in the group chat.
convivio.step3Text: Tap “Propose a Kordata”. To protect those who join you need to become an organiser: an active subscription for at least 30 days, a complete profile, a verified identity and the organiser’s rules accepted.
convivio.step4Text: KUMANI doesn’t handle payments: once the minimum is reached, everyone pays the supplier directly following the organiser’s instructions, and the organiser is responsible for what they propose.

affinity.title: KUMANI Affinity
affinity.summary: A 20-question game to discover your archetype, challenge a friend and meet people on your wavelength.
affinity.step1Text: Tap “Start the game” and answer 20 quick questions: there are no right or wrong answers.
affinity.step1Tip: We only save your map (5 values) and your archetype, never your individual answers. You can delete it whenever you like.
affinity.step2Text: At the end you discover your KUMANI archetype and your Affinity Map on 5 values: adventure, values, rhythm, curiosity and warmth. You can share it or play again.
affinity.step3Text: Tap “Send the Duo link” and send it to a friend or partner: they play, even without signing up, and you instantly find out how compatible you are.
affinity.step4Text: Every week Kumi introduces you to a few people on your wavelength. Choose the languages you speak, add a sentence about yourself, give your consent and tap “Turn on introductions”. The chat only opens if you both say yes.
affinity.step4Tip: Only subscribed adults who chose to take part are included. You can block, report or pause whenever you like.

veritas.title: Veritas
veritas.summary: The “Who’s lying?” game for 3 to 8 players: friends can play even without signing up.
veritas.step1Text: Enter your nickname, choose the question language and number of rounds and tap “Create the room”. Invite friends with the link or code: 3 to 8 players, even without signing up.
veritas.step2Text: If a friend has already created a room, enter their code and tap “Join the room”.
veritas.step3Text: Each round brings a question: everyone writes the truth, except one person who secretly makes something up. Read the anonymous answers and vote for the liar. Whoever spots the liar gets 1 point; the liar gets 1 point for each person fooled.

kumani_cv.title: KUMANI CV
kumani_cv.summary: Create your European-style CV: every PDF has a QR code leading to your always up-to-date public page.
kumani_cv.step1Text: Tap “New CV”. The CV is European-style and every PDF has a QR code leading to your public page: whoever scans it always sees the latest version.
kumani_cv.step2Text: Give the CV a name (for example “Italian CV”), choose the content language and one of the three templates: Minimal, Classic or Sidebar. Then add a photo and your details.
kumani_cv.step2Tip: You can create several CVs, for example one in Italian and one in English.
kumani_cv.step3Text: Fill in the sections with “Add experience”, “Add education”, skills, languages, certifications and links. With “Preview” you see right away how it looks.
kumani_cv.step4Text: Tap “Create CV”. Then you can download the PDF, copy the public link or share it via WhatsApp and email. If you update the CV, the link and QR always show the new version.

findo.title: Findo
findo.summary: Your personal inventory: record where you keep things and find them in a moment.
findo.step1Text: Record where you keep things (documents, tools, valuables) and find them in a moment. To start, tap “Add item”.
findo.step2Text: Add a photo, write what you’re recording, choose where it is (or create a new location), then category and tags. Tap “Save item”.
findo.step2Tip: Locations are reusable: “Bedroom wardrobe”, “Cellar”, “Office”… If you move an item, Findo keeps the history of where it’s been.
findo.step3Text: Search by name, tag or location, show favourites only, or open “Manage locations” to see what’s in each place.

life_calendar.title: Life Calendar
life_calendar.summary: Documents, car, home, contracts and subscriptions: all your deadlines in one place, with renewals and reminders.
life_calendar.step1Title: All your deadlines in one place
life_calendar.step1Text: At the top you see how many deadlines are on track, coming up, urgent or expired. Tap “New deadline” to add one.
life_calendar.step2Text: Write what you want to remember (ID card, car insurance, MOT…), choose the category and, if you like, a profile: a person, a car, a home. Then enter the due date.
life_calendar.step3Text: Choose whether it repeats (every month, every year, every 2 years…) and when to remind you, from 180 days to 1 day before. We remind you on the dashboard and in the MemoLife calendar.

memolife.title: MemoLife
memolife.summary: Your diary: appointments, reminders, notes and contacts, together with bills and deadlines.
memolife.step1Text: MemoLife brings together appointments, reminders, notes and contacts in the Today, Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Contacts tabs. The calendar also shows your Spendly bills and Life Calendar deadlines.
memolife.step2Text: Tap the “+” button at the bottom and choose appointment, reminder, note or contact. From here you can also add a bill (Spendly) or a document deadline (Life Calendar).

spendly.title: Spendly
spendly.summary: Your personal budget month by month: income, bills and expenses under control.
spendly.step1Text: In the “Annual Dashboard” you see the year’s income, fixed expenses, variable expenses and net balance, with the balance trend month by month.
spendly.step2Text: At the top you switch between tabs: Dashboard, Income, Bills, Fixed Expenses and Variable Expenses. In each one, tap “New” to add an entry.
spendly.step3Text: Choose a month to see its details: income, expenses, balance and variable expenses by category. The colours tell you whether the month is positive, on watch or critical.
spendly.step4Text: In the “Bills” tab add electricity, gas, water, phone… with “New bill”: they repeat automatically and you record what you actually paid. If you close a contract, deactivate it.

svat.title: SVAT – Anti-Fraud Check
svat.summary: Check in seconds whether a website, a VAT number or a QR code can be trusted.
svat.step1Text: You can check a website (“Website Check”), a VAT number (“VAT Number Check”) or a QR code (“QR Check”).
svat.step2Text: Enter the website address and tap “Run Verification”: in a few seconds you get a score from 0 to 100 and a verdict.
svat.step3Text: Below you see how many checks are OK, worth watching or risky: domain and DNS, security, content, legal pages, reviews and business model.
svat.step4Text: In the “VAT Number Check” tab enter an Italian or European VAT number to find out whether it’s active and who it belongs to.
svat.step4Tip: A good score is a clue, not a guarantee: before paying, also read the Anti-Scam Manual.

focus.title: KUMANI Focus
focus.summary: Work in intervals: focus and short breaks, with a long break every 4 sessions.
focus.step1Text: Write what you’re focusing on and tap “Start”: the countdown begins. You can skip a phase or start over; a soft sound tells you at every change.
focus.step2Text: Classic 25/5, Long 50/10, Short 15/3 or Custom. You can turn on sound, vibration, keep the screen on and get a notification at every change.
focus.step3Text: See how many sessions you completed and how many minutes you focused today. It resets every day and stays only on your device.
focus.step3Tip: Open “Tips for better focus” for a few suggestions.

mandala.title: KUMANI Mandala
mandala.summary: Draw with one finger: your stroke becomes a symmetrical mandala. No skill required.
mandala.step1Text: Draw a line on the canvas: it’s repeated symmetrically and becomes a mandala in seconds.
mandala.step2Text: Choose the symmetry (6, 8, 12 or 16 segments), a dark or ivory background, brush or eraser, thickness and colour. “Undo” takes a step back, “Clear” starts over.
mandala.step3Text: Tap “Download PNG” to save the drawing and share it, for example on WhatsApp.
mandala.step3Tip: To relax even more, you can listen to Neurobalance waves while you draw.

mosaic.title: KUMANI Mosaic
mosaic.summary: Every Kumano places a few tiles a day on a shared canvas: a work created by the whole community.
mosaic.step1Title: A work of the whole community
mosaic.step1Text: Every Kumano leaves their mark on the shared canvas: nobody owns it, everyone created it. You can zoom in, replay how it grew, share it and download it.
mosaic.step2Text: Every day you get a few tiles: tap a free square, choose a colour and confirm. A placed tile stays forever. Tiles renew at midnight and each season has a theme and an end date.
mosaic.step2Tip: You can place tiles after 7 days of logging in to KUMANI. If you also use another KUMANI service the same day, you get a bonus tile.
mosaic.step3Text: Unlock the season’s achievements: Co-founder of the artwork, Final tile and Mosaicist. If you see offensive writing or an ad, tap one of its tiles and report the area.

oxygen.title: OXYGEN
oxygen.summary: Three minutes to breathe again, with 4-7-8 breathing: breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out for 8.
oxygen.step1Text: Choose the guided session (about 3 minutes, with a few words along the way) or just breathe, and how many cycles: 4 are recommended. You can turn on sound and vibration to breathe with your eyes closed.
oxygen.step2Text: Sit or lie down somewhere quiet, never while driving. The first time do at most 4 cycles and, if you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.
oxygen.step2Tip: OXYGEN is a relaxation exercise, not a medical device: it doesn’t replace a doctor’s advice.
oxygen.step3Text: Tap “Start breathing”: the circle grows and shrinks with you and guides you step by step.

fabula.title: Kumani Fabula
fabula.summary: Six dice, one story: write a micro-story with today’s dice and read the community’s.
fabula.step1Text: In “Today’s roll” the dice are the same for the whole community and change at midnight. With “Free roll” you can roll whenever you like.
fabula.step2Text: Tap “Roll the dice”: you get a character, place, object, emotion, action and atmosphere. Write a micro-story (up to 900 characters) that uses them all; if you like, try the 60-second challenge.
fabula.step3Text: Publish the story in the “Gallery” or keep it in “My stories”. Read how others told the same dice, in seven languages: no rankings, just applause.
fabula.step3Tip: Write every day to earn the “Steady pen” achievement.

neurobalance.title: Neurobalance
neurobalance.summary: Audio sessions with binaural frequencies and nature sounds, for a relaxing break.
neurobalance.step1Text: Put on stereo headphones, choose a session (for example “Deep rest”, “Fluid focus” or “Mindful reset”), adjust the volume and tap “Start session”.
neurobalance.step2Text: Carrier frequencies to listen to with stereo headphones, at a low, comfortable volume. Tap the play button next to the one you want.
neurobalance.step3Text: Rain, ocean, stream, forest, wind, fire, night and thunderstorm: turn one on and mix it into your session.
neurobalance.step3Tip: Neurobalance is meant for relaxation, it isn’t a therapy.

aureya.title: Aureya
aureya.summary: Three quick self-check tests, hearing, visual acuity and the Amsler grid, to repeat and compare over time.
aureya.step1Text: Aureya is a self-check tool, not a medical device, and doesn’t replace a check-up. Results depend on headphones, volume, screen, light and distance: they’re indicative.
aureya.step2Text: You hear a series of tones at different frequencies, one ear at a time, and tap “I hear it” as soon as you perceive them. Between sounds there’s a pause of silence of varying length: tap only when you really hear the sound.
aureya.step3Title: Visual acuity and the Amsler grid
aureya.step3Text: In the visual acuity test you say which way the letter “E” is facing as it gets smaller, with no time limit. In the Amsler grid you look at the dot in the centre and mark the areas where the lines look wavy, blurred or missing. Both are done one eye at a time.
aureya.step3Tip: The first time you measure the screen by placing a credit card on it: this shows the letter and grid at the right size.
aureya.step4Text: Each test saves the date and result in the “Test history”, so you can compare them over time.
aureya.step4Tip: If you notice a decline, wavy lines or missing areas, especially for the first time, see a doctor or an eye specialist.

travel.title: KUMANI Travel
travel.summary: The trip that organises itself: a day-by-day itinerary and checklist shared with your travel companions.
travel.step1Text: Tap “New trip”, add dates and activities: the itinerary builds day by day. In the checklist, note what not to forget and who’s taking care of it.
travel.step1Tip: Creating a trip requires a subscription; joining a trip you were invited to doesn’t.
travel.step2Title: Invite or join with a code
travel.step2Text: From the trip, tap “Invite to the trip” and send the link or code to your companions. If you received a code, enter it under “Got an invite code?” and tap “Join”.

fincheck.title: FinCheck
fincheck.summary: The financial-education quiz and your budget check-up: find out where your money goes and how to make ends meet.
fincheck.step1Text: Open FinCheck and tap “Start the quiz”: 15 simple questions about your money habits, about 3 minutes. The quiz is free.
fincheck.step2Text: One question at a time on awareness, saving, debt, spending and the future. Pick the answer closest to what you really do; tap “Back” to change it.
fincheck.step3Text: At the end you see your profile, your score out of 45 and a traffic light for each of the 5 areas, with a tip for the ones to improve.
fincheck.step3Tip: Your results are private: only you can see them.
fincheck.step4Text: If you use Spendly, FinCheck works out the average of the last 3 months: income, expenses, what you have left, the 50/30/20 rule and a traffic light for housing, loans, subscriptions and other indicators.
fincheck.step4Tip: The check-up is included from the Base plan and works best with 3 months of income and expenses recorded in Spendly.
fincheck.step5Text: FinCheck suggests up to 3 concrete goals, with amounts based on your budget: tick them off when done. After 3 months, retake the quiz to see your progress.
fincheck.step5Tip: You get KU Karma for the quiz the first time and then every 3 months.

menu.title: KUMANI Menu
menu.summary: Your venue’s menu online, with a QR on the table and in several languages.
menu.step1Text: Create the menu with your venue’s name, style and languages. In the “Your online menu” tab you’ll find the link, the QR to download, the menu as a PDF and the card to put on the table.
menu.step1Tip: With “Settings” you change the style, languages and review link.
menu.step2Text: Tap “Add category” (for example Starters), then “Add dish” in each category. Use the arrows to change the order and “Available” to mark a dish as sold out.
menu.step3Text: Enter the name, price, photo and description in each language, then choose the features (vegan, gluten-free…) and the allergens. You can also mark it as “Dish of the day”.
menu.step3Tip: “Translate with AI” fills in the missing translations in one click.
menu.step4Title: The menu as the customer sees it
menu.step4Text: The customer scans the QR and sees the menu in their language, with the dish of the day highlighted and the allergens for each dish.

fidelity.title: Kumi Card
fidelity.summary: The digital loyalty card: stamps on the customer’s phone, the reward and the stats.
fidelity.step1Text: Create the card with your business name, the reward and the number of stamps, then tap “Open till mode” on the phone or tablet you keep at the till.
fidelity.step1Tip: On other devices the till unlocks with the PIN you choose.
fidelity.step2Text: In till mode choose how many stamps to give and tap “Give stamp”: a QR appears for the customer to scan with their phone. This is also where you hand over the reward.
fidelity.step3Text: The customer sees the stamps collected, the reward and how many stamps are left, without downloading any app. At the till they can also show their code.
fidelity.step4Text: On your page you see stamps per week and the busiest days and times, plus customers, rewards given and the average return rate.
fidelity.step5Text: In “Your customers” you find who is close to the reward and, if they gave consent, you contact them with “Write on WhatsApp” to bring them back.

preventivi.title: Quotes
preventivi.summary: Professional quotes with your letterhead, as a PDF, to send on WhatsApp or by email.
preventivi.step1Text: The first time, fill in the Company Profile with your logo, company name, VAT number and contacts: they appear at the top of every quote.
preventivi.step2Text: Tap “New quote” and enter the customer’s details, or pick a customer you’ve already saved.
preventivi.step3Text: In “Quote items” write the description, quantity and price; with “Add item” you add more. The total is calculated automatically.
preventivi.step3Tip: Also add the payment method and notes: they appear in the PDF.
preventivi.step4Text: After “Create quote” you see the summary with the customer, the items, the total and the validity dates.
preventivi.step5Text: Tap “Download PDF” and send it to the customer on WhatsApp or by email. With “Edit” you can change it whenever you like.

digital_receipt.title: Digital Receipts
digital_receipt.summary: A digital receipt for every delivery or loan, confirmed by the recipient.
digital_receipt.step1Text: Here you find all your receipts with their status: Pending, Confirmed or Returned. Tap “New receipt” to create one.
digital_receipt.step2Title: Choose the type and fill in
digital_receipt.step2Text: Choose the type (delivery, loan, keys, documents…), add a photo if you like and write the item, recipient and date. Then tap “Create receipt”.
digital_receipt.step2Tip: For a loan you can set the return date and get a reminder.
digital_receipt.step3Text: Copy the link or let the recipient scan the QR. You can also download the PDF; when the loan ends, tap “Confirm return”.
digital_receipt.step4Text: The recipient opens the link, with no account needed, and taps “I confirm I received the above”. The receipt becomes “Confirmed”.

magazzino.title: Magazzino PRO
magazzino.summary: Products, stock levels, stock in and out and reorder alerts in one place.
magazzino.step1Text: At the top you see the stock value, products below minimum stock, this month’s movements and the average margin.
magazzino.step2Text: Tap “New product” and enter the name, category, unit of measure, cost, selling price, minimum stock and opening stock.
magazzino.step2Tip: With “Scan code” you find a product by scanning its barcode.
magazzino.step3Text: On each product use the stock in, stock out or stocktake buttons: choose the reason and quantity and save. The stock level updates automatically.
magazzino.step4Text: In the “Dashboard” you find the stock value, the products to reorder and the most moved ones. From “Products” and “Movements” you export everything as CSV for your accountant.

qr_code_pro.title: QR Code PRO
qr_code_pro.summary: Dynamic QR codes: change the destination whenever you like and count the scans.
qr_code_pro.step1Text: Here you find all your QR codes with the number of scans. Tap “New QR Code” to create one.
qr_code_pro.step2Text: Give the QR a name and choose what it should do: open a website, write on WhatsApp, call, send an SMS or an email, connect to WiFi or save a contact. Then choose the colours and tap “Create QR Code”.
qr_code_pro.step3Title: Download and change whenever you like
qr_code_pro.step3Text: In the details you see the scans, copy the dynamic link and download the QR. If you change the destination, the QR you’ve already printed keeps working.
qr_code_pro.step3Tip: Print the QR on flyers and business cards: you’ll never need to reprint them.

firma_email.title: Email Signature
firma_email.summary: A professional email signature with your details, your socials and the link to your Link in Bio.
firma_email.step1Text: Choose between Classic, Compact and Modern.
firma_email.step2Text: Write your name, role and company, then your contacts: phone, mobile, email, website and address.
firma_email.step2Tip: The draft stays saved on this device.
firma_email.step3Text: Choose your brand colour and paste the links to your social profiles. You can also add the link to your Link in Bio.
firma_email.step4Text: Check the preview and tap “Copy signature”. You can also copy the HTML code or download the file.
firma_email.step5Text: In “How to add the signature” you find the steps for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and iPhone.

calcolatrici.title: PRO Calculators
calcolatrici.summary: VAT, discounts, markup and margin, withholding tax: everyday sums in a moment.
calcolatrici.step1Text: In the “VAT” tab choose whether to add or remove VAT, enter the amount and the rate: you immediately see the net amount, the VAT and the total.
calcolatrici.step2Text: In the “Discount” tab enter the price and the discount as a percentage, in euros or stacked: you see the final price and the saving.
calcolatrici.step3Text: Enter the cost and selling price to see markup, margin and profit, or work out the price starting from the margin or markup you want.
calcolatrici.step4Text: From the fee you work out the net amount to pay and the invoice total, with pension contribution and VAT, or start from the net amount you want to receive.
calcolatrici.step4Tip: Copy the result with “Copy result”. The calculation is indicative: always check with your accountant.

landing_page.title: Landing Page
landing_page.summary: Your business website on kumani.io: copy written with AI, colours of your choice, contact details and a QR code to share.
landing_page.step1Text: Open “Write the copy with AI” and answer the questions: what you do, where, for whom and which services you offer. Tap “Write the draft”: the AI prepares the introduction, services, about me, method and the description for Google.
landing_page.step1Tip: The AI only uses what you write: always reread the draft before publishing.
landing_page.step2Text: In “Address and language” choose the page address (kumani.io/p/…) and the language you write in. In “Style” choose between Elegant dark, Light and Colourful, and pick the main colour.
landing_page.step3Text: In “Introduction” add your name, headline, photo, logo and the main button (WhatsApp, call, email or link). In “Page blocks” make the ones you need visible, fill them in and change their order with the arrows.
landing_page.step3Tip: In Testimonials only publish genuine quotes from real customers, with their consent.
landing_page.step4Text: Tick “Publish the page” and tap “Save”. At the top you’ll find your address with “Copy”, “Open” and “Download QR”, ready for business cards, your shop window and social media.
landing_page.step4Tip: In “Business details” enter your company name and VAT number, if you have one.
landing_page.step5Title: The page as customers see it
landing_page.step5Text: Anyone who opens the link sees your page on their phone or computer and can contact you with one tap, including through the “Message me” form: messages arrive in the “Messages” tab, on your dashboard and as a notification on your phone.

garage.title: Kumani Garage
garage.summary: Your cars in one place: lease mileage tracking, deadlines with reminders and expenses that also go into Spendly.
garage.step1Text: Tap «Add car» and choose whether it is owned or leased. Enter a name, make and model and, if you like, the number plate.
garage.step2Text: For a long-term lease enter pickup date, duration in months, included km and monthly payment. With the cost per extra km we also tell you how much you might pay at the end of the contract.
garage.step2Tip: Tick «Also add the monthly payment to Spendly fixed expenses» to find it in your monthly budget.
garage.step3Title: Update the mileage and check the budget
garage.step3Text: Every now and then enter the current km with the date: you instantly see if you are within budget, how many km per day you can still drive and the end-of-contract projection.
garage.step4Text: Add road tax, insurance, inspection and service: they appear in the Home agenda and we remind you ahead of time. When you pay, tap «Paid»: it becomes a car expense, also in Spendly.

s1.title: Hands that lend you a hand.
s1.notes: Welcome. KUMANI is an ecosystem of digital tools for everyday use, for the self-employed as well as individuals and families. In this presentation we will see what it is, what it offers, how much it costs, and how points and donations work.

s2.title: What the name means
s2.sub: Two words, one promise: hands together.

1.3: Group, people working side by side.

2.2: the oldest Italian word for work
2.3: The hands that build, help, create.

3.3: And inside it you can hear “umani”, humans: people are at the centre.

s2.notes: KU comes from the Japanese kumi: a group, people working side by side. MANI is the oldest Italian word for work: hands. KUMANI means hands together. And if you hear the Italian word umani, humans, inside it, that is no accident.

s3.title: Why KUMANI was born

1.2: Extraordinary people, with big hearts and an empty toolbox.

2.2: They needed extra hands: one for the QR code, one for the agenda, one for the quote, one to breathe.

3.2: One place, all the tools, an honest price. Not dreams: tools.

s3.notes: KUMANI was born from watching self-employed people: salespeople, consultants, craftspeople. They had ideas and drive, but not the tools. That is how the promise was born: one place, all the tools, an honest price.

s4.title: The KUMANI Manifesto
s4.sub: Six sentences that guide every choice.

4.2: €49 a year for Base, €149 a year for Pro.

5.2: that’s why we also teach you to breathe.

6.2: public rules, real benefits, no tricks.

s4.notes: The manifesto is our identity card. We do not promise earnings: we provide tools. The price is public and the same for everyone.

s5.title: The KUMANI Ecosystem in four numbers
s5.sub: One account, tools that talk to each other.

2.3: Italian, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Russian

s5.notes: Forty-two services: sixteen free for anyone who signs up, seventeen more with the Base plan, nine more with the Pro plan. Everything in seven languages. The Base plan costs 49 euros a year, less than one euro a week. Pro can be tried free for fifteen days.

s6.title: Six areas, one account
s6.sub: Some examples of the services included.

1.2: QR Code, Link in Bio, WhatsApp Messages, Email Signature, KUMANI Menu, Kumi Card

2.2: SVAT, VeriFoto, CheckMail, IBAN Check, Safe Document, Anti-Scam Manual

3.2: MemoLife, Life Calendar, Spendly, Kumani Garage, Findo, KUMANI Travel, KUMANI CV

4.2: Neurobalance, Aureya, Oxygen, Mandala, KUMANI Focus

5.2: Find a Job, Quotes, Digital Receipts, Magazzino PRO, PRO Calculators

6.2: Listings, Kordata, Time Bank, Events, Affinity, Veritas, Mosaic, Fabula

s6.notes: The services are grouped into six areas: getting noticed, protection against scams, personal organisation, wellbeing, work, community and fun. One account gives access to all of them.

s7.title: Tools that talk to each other
s7.sub: Not separate tools: each one feeds the others.

2.2: departures and passport expiry in your agenda

3.2: the table QR leads to your contacts

5.2: every tool you use grows your KU Karma

6.2: QR pass in the wallet, event in the agenda

s7.notes: The strength of KUMANI is that the tools talk to each other. The agenda gathers appointments, bills and deadlines. Trips land in the calendar. The restaurant menu leads to the Kumi Card. And every tool you use adds points to your wallet.

s8.title: Three plans, an honest price
s8.sub: Signing up is free. Each plan includes the previous one.

1.4: To get started, no credit card
1.6: QR Code, WhatsApp Messages, IBAN Check, Listings, Kordata, Time Bank, games and wellbeing

2.6: MemoLife, Spendly, Life Calendar, Link in Bio, SVAT, CheckMail, Neurobalance, Travel, Find a Job

3.4: For those who work with clients
3.6: KUMANI Menu, Kumi Card, Quotes, Digital Receipts, Magazzino, QR Code PRO, Landing Page. 15 days free.

s9.title: The tools for your business
s9.sub: Pro plan: for shops, restaurants, craftspeople and freelancers.

1.2: Table QR menu, in several languages, always up to date

2.2: The loyalty card on your customer’s phone

3.2: With your logo, as PDF, by email or WhatsApp

4.2: Deliveries and deposits confirmed by the customer

5.2: Stock and barcodes from your phone

svat.description: Check whether a website, VAT number or QR code can be trusted before you pay: a 0–100 trust score based on domain, security, legal pages and reviews.
svat.heading: How to tell if a website is legit before you buy
svat.intro: An online shop with prices that look too good to be true, a site created last week, a QR code stuck on a parking meter: before you pay, it pays to check. SVAT analyses the address in seconds and gives you a trust score from 0 to 100, showing what looks fine and what doesn’t.
points: Check a website: domain age, DNS, security, content, legal pages and reviews
Check an Italian or EU VAT number: whether it’s active and who it’s registered to
Check a QR code before opening it, to avoid trap links
See which checks are OK, worth watching or risky

faq.q: How can I tell if a website is a scam?
faq.a: No check gives absolute certainty, but some signs help a lot: a domain registered only a few days ago, no VAT number or legal pages, missing or suspicious reviews, prices far below normal. SVAT checks these and other signs and sums them up in a score.

faq.q: Does a high score mean the website is 100% safe?
faq.a: No. The score is a hint, not a guarantee: even a site with a good score can hide problems. Before paying, use payment methods with buyer protection, such as a credit card, and be wary of anyone asking for instant bank transfers or top-ups.

faq.q: Can I check a foreign VAT number?
faq.a: Yes, SVAT checks Italian and EU VAT numbers and tells you whether they are active and who they are registered to.

verifica_iban.title: IBAN checker: validate an IBAN before a bank transfer
verifica_iban.description: Check that an IBAN is correctly written, which country and bank it belongs to, and which scam warning signs to look for before you send money.
verifica_iban.heading: How to check an IBAN before making a bank transfer
verifica_iban.intro: An instant bank transfer can’t be cancelled, so it’s worth checking the IBAN before you pay. IBAN Check tells you whether it’s correctly written and which country it’s from, and for Italian IBANs it shows the bank and branch. The check happens entirely on your phone: the IBAN is never sent or stored.
points: Check whether the IBAN is correctly written and where the mistake is
See the country and, for Italian IBANs, the ABI (bank), CAB (branch) and account number
Get the scam warning signs to look for based on what you’re paying for
No data sent: the check stays on your device

faq.q: Does a valid IBAN mean the recipient is honest?
faq.a: No. A valid IBAN only means the code is correctly written, not who is behind it. Many scams use perfectly valid IBANs: look at the other signs too, such as pressure to hurry or a price that’s too low.

faq.q: How do I find out which bank an Italian IBAN belongs to?
faq.a: An Italian IBAN contains the ABI code, which identifies the bank, and the CAB code, which identifies the branch. IBAN Check splits them out and shows them to you.

faq.q: What should I do if I’ve already sent money to a scammer?
faq.a: Contact your bank straight away to ask for the transfer to be recalled, and report it to the police and your national cybercrime or fraud reporting service. The faster you act, the better the chance of getting your money back.

checkmail.title: Suspicious email? Check if it’s phishing · CheckMail
checkmail.description: Received a suspicious email? CheckMail checks the sender, links, attachments and wording and tells you if the phishing risk is low, medium or high.
checkmail.heading: How to spot a phishing email
checkmail.intro: Held parcels, suspended accounts, refunds waiting to be claimed: scam emails imitate the banks, couriers and services you use every day. With CheckMail you upload or paste the suspicious email and in seconds you see what doesn’t add up: sender, links, attachments and words meant to rush you.
points: Analyses the real sender, even when the display name is fake
Checks hidden and shortened links
Flags dangerous attachments and requests for personal data
Tells you what to do: don’t click, don’t reply, contact the company through its official channels

faq.q: How can I tell if an email is phishing?
faq.a: The most common signs are a sender that doesn’t match the company, links leading to addresses other than the official ones, urgent wording (“within 24 hours”) and requests for passwords, codes or card details. CheckMail looks for them for you.

faq.q: Can I check an email on my phone?
faq.a: Yes: just copy the sender, subject and text with the links. On a computer you can also upload the email file (.eml or .msg) for a more thorough check.

faq.q: I clicked a suspicious link: what should I do?
faq.a: Don’t enter any details. If you already have, change that service’s password straight away, tell your bank if cards or accounts are involved, and turn on two-step verification.

Second opinion from an AI detector and reverse image search

faq.q: Can VeriFoto say for certain whether a photo is fake?
faq.a: No, no tool can do that with certainty. VeriFoto gathers clues and sums them up in a risk level: if in doubt, don’t trust it.

faq.q: How can I find out if a photo was stolen from the internet?
faq.a: Search for the same image with Google Lens or TinEye: if it appears on other sites under other names, that’s a strong sign of a fake profile or listing. VeriFoto takes you straight to these searches.

faq.q: Are my photos saved?
faq.a: The basic checks happen on your device. Only if you choose the AI detector’s second opinion is a reduced copy of the photo sent, and only after you’ve agreed to it.

antitruffa.title: Anti-Scam Manual: the most common scams and how to avoid them
antitruffa.description: Text, email, phone, chat, online shopping and investment scams: real examples, the 10-second test and what to do right away if you’ve been scammed.
antitruffa.heading: The most common scams and how to spot them
antitruffa.intro: The fake courier, the fake bank adviser, the son or daughter texting from a new number, the investment with returns too good to be true: scams change shape but look alike. The Anti-Scam Manual gathers them into chapters, with real examples and what to do right away. You can download it, print it and share it with the people you love.
points: The 10-second test: 6 questions to ask yourself before you click, reply or pay
The 6 golden rules that prevent most scams
Chapters on emails and texts, phone calls, the doorstep, chats, shopping and investments
What to do right away if you’ve been scammed

faq.q: What are the most common scams today?
faq.a: Among the most common are texts and emails from a fake courier or fake bank, calls from fake advisers, messages from relatives asking for money from a new number, fake online listings and investments with promised returns.

faq.q: Can I give the manual to my parents?
faq.a: Yes, that’s exactly what it’s designed for: you can print it, save it as a PDF or send the link via WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram or email.

faq.q: What should I do if I’ve been scammed?
faq.a: Block your cards and accounts straight away by calling your bank, change your passwords, keep messages and receipts, and report it to the police and your national cybercrime or fraud reporting service. The manual has a chapter with all the steps.

documento_sicuro.title: Send a photo of your ID safely with a watermark · Safe Document
documento_sicuro.description: Before sending your ID card, add a watermark with the purpose and date and cover the details that aren’t needed. The photo stays on your phone.
documento_sicuro.heading: How to send a photo of your ID card safely
documento_sicuro.intro: Renting, a new job, online purchases: we’re often asked for a photo of an ID document. But a copy in circulation can be used for identity theft. With Safe Document you add text stating the purpose and date, cover the details that aren’t needed and remove hidden data, such as GPS location.
points: Watermark with purpose, recipient and date repeated across the whole photo
Cover the document number, signature or photo if they aren’t needed
Removes hidden data, such as GPS location
The photo is never uploaded or stored: everything happens on your phone

faq.q: Why add a watermark to an ID document?
faq.a: Text such as “For rental agreement only – 3 October” makes the copy much harder to use for other purposes, such as opening accounts or making purchases in your name.

faq.q: Can the recipient still read the details?
faq.a: Yes, the watermark keeps the details readable. If the recipient needs something you’ve covered, you can create a new copy without covering it.

faq.q: Is the photo of my document uploaded to the internet?
faq.a: No. The photo stays on your phone and the original isn’t touched: you only download or share the protected copy.

fincheck.title: Financial literacy quiz and budget check-up · FinCheck

fincheck.heading: How good are you at managing your money?

Score and traffic light for each area, with practical tips
Budget check-up with the 50/30/20 rule if you use Spendly
Action plan with up to 3 concrete goals

faq.q: What is the 50/30/20 rule?
faq.a: It’s a simple way to split your income: about 50% for needs (housing, bills, groceries), 30% for wants and 20% for savings and debt. FinCheck works it out on your real budget if you use Spendly.

faq.q: Does FinCheck give investment advice?
faq.a: No. FinCheck is financial education: it helps you understand your habits and balance your budget. It doesn’t recommend financial products or investments.

faq.q: Who can see my results?
faq.a: Only you: your quiz and check-up results are private.

spendly.title: Household budget app: income, expenses and bills · Spendly
spendly.description: Track your personal budget month by month: income, bills, fixed and variable expenses, balance and the year’s trend. Simple, from your phone.

Recurring bills that repeat automatically, with what you actually paid
Variable expenses split by category
Colours that tell you at a glance whether the month is positive or critical

faq.q: How do you make a household budget?
faq.a: Start with the month’s income, then subtract fixed costs (rent, repayments, subscriptions), bills and variable expenses (groceries, fuel, leisure). Spendly does the maths for you and shows you the balance.

faq.q: Do I have to link my bank account?
faq.a: No. In Spendly you enter the items yourself: there’s no need to link accounts or cards.

faq.q: Can I use Spendly with FinCheck?
faq.a: Yes: once you’ve recorded a few months of income and expenses, FinCheck uses your Spendly data for the budget check-up.

Sold-out dishes and dish of the day updated in one click

faq.q: What kinds of businesses is it for?

Reminder for the return date of loans
PDF to download and status always visible: pending, confirmed or returned

faq.q: Can I use it when lending an item?

faq.q: Is it legally binding?

magazzino.title: Simple inventory management for small businesses · Magazzino PRO

neurobalance.title: Binaural beats and nature sounds for relaxation · Neurobalance

points: Sessions such as “Deep rest”, “Fluid focus” and “Mindful reset”
Nature sounds: rain, ocean, stream, forest, wind, fire, night and thunderstorm
Adjustable volume and sounds you can mix
Designed for relaxation, to listen to with stereo headphones

faq.q: What are binaural beats?
faq.a: They are two slightly different tones, one in each ear, that are perceived as a single beat. That’s why you need stereo headphones.

faq.q: Is Neurobalance a therapy?
faq.a: No, it’s designed for relaxation; it isn’t a therapy and doesn’t replace a doctor’s advice.

faq.q: Can I use it while studying or working?
faq.a: You can use it as background sound during a break or while you concentrate, at a low, comfortable volume. Don’t use it while driving.

Sound and vibration so you can breathe with your eyes closed
Tips for doing it safely

faq.q: What is 4-7-8 breathing?
faq.a: It’s a breathing exercise: you breathe in for 4 seconds, hold your breath for 7 and breathe out slowly for 8.

faq.q: How many cycles should I do?
faq.a: The first time, do no more than 4 cycles. If you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.

faq.q: Can I do it while driving?
faq.a: No. Do it sitting or lying down somewhere quiet. OXYGEN is a relaxation exercise, not a medical device.

Today’s sessions and minutes of focus

faq.q: What is the Pomodoro technique?

faq.q: Can I change the length of the sessions?

Community story gallery, with no leaderboards

garage.description: Always know if you are within your lease mileage: day-by-day budget, end-of-contract projection and extra-km cost. Plus road tax, insurance, inspection and car expenses.

faq.q: How is lease mileage calculated?

faq.q: Is it useful for a car I own?
